sources.quote: Once again, NASA is asking for ideas to rescue Hubble from certain death

claims.statement: NASA is seeking commercial-industry proposals to reboost Hubble's orbit.

sources.quote: The space agency solicited ideas for reboosting Hubble four years ago, but they didn't go anywhere.

claims.statement: NASA previously solicited similar reboost ideas about four years earlier, with no mission result.

sources.quote: its time will run out in the early to mid 2030s unless its orbit is boosted

claims.statement: Hubble's orbit will decay enough to threaten the telescope by the early-to-mid 2030s absent a boost.

headline: NASA again seeks commercial help to rescue Hubble from decaying orbit
summary: NASA is soliciting proposals from the commercial space industry to boost Hubble's orbit and extend its life, after its orbit decays without intervention. Outlets note NASA tried a similar solicitation four years ago without a mission resulting.
